author: Bellular News
description:
Gaming hardware is getting more expensive, and the ugly bit is that this may not be a temporary spike. Xbox is raising prices, memory costs are still climbing, lawsuits are hitting the RAM giants, and if fewer new players can buy in, everyone already inside the hobby becomes the place companies make the money back.
